# Korean classroom text attribution

Verified against official sources on 2026-10-04.

## Simplified dictionary definitions

The eight `KOREAN_CONTENT.dictionary.entries[].definition` strings in content.js are adaptations of the selected senses in 국립국어원 우리말샘, provided under [CC BY-SA 2.0 KR](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/kr/). Changes: definitions simplified for children. Preserve attribution, these sense links, change notice, and the same license when sharing this adapted definition dataset.

Official [dictionary copyright policy](https://kdict.korean.go.kr/info/copyright).

This share-alike notice applies to the adapted definition dataset, not the whole game, program code, visual assets, or unrelated original content. The examples are newly authored for Dormi and are not dictionary quotations. No attributed literary examples, images, audio, or videos are reused.

## Other learning text

The sentence exercises, corrections, and modern historical explanations use the verified content handoff. Per-item official source links remain in content.js and are displayed in the source-details controls. The modern caption is explicitly labeled as a present-day paraphrase. The 15th-century underlying title is historical public-domain text; modern translations, calligraphy images, fonts, and facsimile photographs are separate works.
